title: test/test_cases.json (Stage 4B — skeleton derived by 05/scripts/derive_test_cases.py, steps completed by the LLM, validated by 05/scripts/validate_test_cases.py, executed by 07/scripts/run_closed_loop_eval.py)

schemaIdentifiersIgnored.description: Plain-English single-word column names excluded from scanning to avoid false positives on labels.

enumCodesWarnOnly.description: Single-word all-caps codes (state/trigger codes such as DRAFT or SUBMIT and short OpenAPI enum members) that may also be legitimate words in visible text; reported as warnings only. Multi-word UPPER_SNAKE codes stay in enumCodes (FAIL-level).

legacyIdentifiers.description: Real legacy object names (tables, XSD elements, form/report/control names) from specs/input_inventory.json#legacyObjectNames; FAIL-level when rendered.

legacyIdentifiersWarnOnly.description: Bare legacy file-name stems (specs/input_inventory.json#legacyFileStems); a collision is reported as a warning only.

piiPatterns.description: Regexes for unmasked sensitive values (from spec Pillar 2 PII inventory).

retiredTestCases.description: Test cases that existed in a previous derivation but are no longer derived (kept for audit; not executed).

deferredByGroupSelection.description: True when the parent story belongs to an unselected Capability Group in Product Backlog (when selectedCapabilityGroups != ['ALL']).

optional.description: Optional tests never block the Stage 6 verdict (default false).

needsSteps.description: true while the LLM still has to author/complete steps; validate_test_cases.py fails on any true.

derivationKey.description: Stable key used to preserve authored steps across re-derivation (e.g. 'ac:US-FUNC-01/AC-02', 'illegal:Draft/Approve', 'role:Applicant/Approve', 'api:GET /api/x').

derivation.description: Free-form provenance (state, trigger, role, method, path, tag).

steps.description: At least one step; every non-deferred test case must also contain ≥ 1 assertion step (expect* or httpRequest with expectStatus/expectJsonPath).
